houses.name: General Rhino
houses.line: Stand firm, protect our fords, and let the valley echo with the thunder of our hooves!

houses.name: Kite's Wing
houses.line: Hawks circle high. We hold the fords, we watch the mist, we strike when the river runs red.

houses.name: Orchid's Iron Petals
houses.line: We bloom in mud and blood — hold the fords, break their charge, bring home the standards.

houses.name: The Iron Stripe
houses.line: Hold the banks, guard the fords, and let the river run red with the blood of our enemies.
